subject: Mutual Action Plan: exec roster confirmation + EB calendaring request
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@nimbushealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan: exec roster confirmation + EB calendaring request

Samantha / Tom — attaching a first-pass MAP and a proposed EB (executive board) meeting agenda. Our ask here is two-fold: confirm the executive sponsor roster and lock one 60‑minute EB slot in the week of June 7 so procurement and clinical evals can align.

Highlights in the attached MAP (Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Key milestones: eval environment provision (May 28), clinical pilot (Jun 14–Jun 21), final decision (Jun 30)
- Success criteria: latency under 200ms for core inference path; end‑to‑end integration test for patient-data deidentification
- Owner suggestions: Dr. Elena Park for clinical sponsor; Tom or Samantha to confirm procurement reviewer

Can you confirm: (1) who from Nimbus will attend the EB (title + proxy), (2) three preferred EB time windows the week of June 7, and (3) which validation metric you want prioritized in the pilot?

Thanks — I’ll circulate a calendar hold once we have preferred slots.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Sr. Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0143

From: Samantha Cole <samantha.cole@nimbushealth.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>, procurement@nimbushealth.com
Date: 2027-05-24T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: exec roster confirmation + EB calendaring request

Thanks Stephanie — quick replies inline.

1) Exec attendees: Dr. Elena Park (Chief Medical Officer) — confirmed; Rajiv Mehta (VP Product) to join if available; procurement will loop in a reviewer (procurement@nimbushealth.com) for contract checklist.
2) EB availability (preferred windows):
   - Tue Jun 8, 10:00–11:00 PT
   - Wed Jun 9, 14:00–15:00 PT
   - Thu Jun 10, 09:00–10:00 PT
3) Priority metric: clinical false-positive reduction for alerting (we need model precision above 91% on the retrospective set).

I also attached our procurement intake email thread (we’ll send formal SOW questions after EB).

— Samantha
Director, Clinical Partnerships
Nimbus Health
Samantha.Cole@nimbushealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-25T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan: exec roster confirmation + EB calendaring request

Looping in a couple of operational notes from the EB playbook side — suggest we: 

- Pair internal execs to customer execs: Eduardo (our Head of Product Ops) with Dr. Park for clinical gating; Ben to cover procurement/legal questions.
- Move the pilot provisioning forward: target May 28 as Stephanie outlined, but add a short smoke test window (May 29–31) to validate data ingestion so the EB can sign off on scope.
- Tighten the MAP success criteria to include an ingestion SLA: sample latency < 300ms and batch throughput for nightly jobs.

I updated the attached EB_agenda_draft.pdf with a 20‑minute decision window at the end of the meeting and a roll/fallback plan if the procurement reviewer is missing. Happy to own the run-of-show.

Marissa
VP, Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>

Thanks — updated MAP attached (Nimbus_MAP_v1.xlsx -> MAP_v1 with notes).

Per availability, locking Wed Jun 9, 14:00–15:00 PT as a tentative EB slot (Samantha’s second option). I’ll send a calendar hold to the confirmed list once Tom confirms Rajiv’s attendance.

Quick clarifications:
- We’ll run the smoke tests May 29–31; Karhtik to provision the eval cluster and share the ingestion checklist by May 26 (Karhtik: can you confirm ETA?).
- Ben, can you prepare a short procurement summary (key terms we expect: data retention 90 days, KMS/HSM notes) so procurement has a concrete starting point?

Next actions:
1) Karhtik: provisioning checklist by EOD May 26
2) Ben: procurement summary by May 28
3) Stephanie: calendar hold to go out once Rajiv's confirmed (target May 28)

— Stephanie

From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nimbushealth.com>

Stephanie — quick update from my side. Dr. Park confirmed and Rajiv can make the Wed Jun 9 slot. Procurement will review Ben’s summary and send any SOW redlines — they also attached a signed NDA (NDA_signed_v1.pdf) to speed the legal review.

One change request: our clinical team also wants a short demo of the deidentification flow inside a staging EHR export. Can we include a 15‑minute demo immediately before the EB (Wed Jun 9, 13:30–13:45 PT) so the clinical reviewers can see the pipeline live?

If that works, we’ll be ready to proceed to the pilot provisioning.

— Tom
Head of Integrations
Nimbus Health

Perfect — thanks Tom and Samantha.

Confirmed: Wed Jun 9, 13:30–13:45 PT (staging demo) + 14:00–15:00 PT (EB). Calendar holds will go out in the next hour to the confirmed list: Dr. Elena Park, Rajiv Mehta, Tom Alvarez, Samantha Cole; and Redwood attendees: Stephanie Nguyen, Marissa Cole, Ben Carter, Karthik Iyer, Eduardo Morales (internal product ops — will be added to the event).

Deliverables recap (owners & due dates):
- Karhtik Iyer: eval provisioning + ingestion checklist — completed (thanks).
- Ben Carter: procurement summary & terms draft — due 2027-05-28 (Ben: please flag any blockers).
- Marissa Cole: run-of-show & EB decision slate — ready, will lead the 20‑minute decision window.
- Stephanie Nguyen: update MAP in Drive and HubSpot, create DocuSign route for procurement SOW — in progress (link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/NIM-4321/MAP_v2).

We’ll treat the EB as the formal gating meeting for the commitment step; if all decision criteria are met then we’ll convert to an executed SOW within five business days.

Thanks everyone — sending the holds now.
